partnershipPlan: Two farmer partners from the client group review the planning guide and the observation checklist; a farm worker reviews the visitor-control wording.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments from the practice's client evenings are summarised.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Every leaflet says the same fifteen things; tell me the two that matter on my farm.
items.implication: Limit each plan to three agreed priorities.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Where am I supposed to keep bought-in heifers for three weeks? Every shed is full in winter.
items.implication: Offer alternatives when isolation is not possible.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: A two-hour visit is fine once, but I cannot chase twenty farms every month.
items.implication: Record vet time per herd as a balancing measure.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: When the farm next door bought in stock, we lost half our calves to scours that spring.
items.implication: Explain the risk to neighbours in the planning visit.

summary: Four composite voices on generic advice, housing, vet time and neighbouring herds.
